{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the number of non-missing rows and the mean body mass
n_non_missing = len(df_clean)
mean_body_mass = df_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Print both values
n_non_missing, mean_body_mass"}
